class.name: SubtitlePlayer
class.brief_description: Plays a [Subtitle] in sync with an audio, video or animation player and signals when segments change.

method.name: get_playback
method.description: Returns the [SubtitlePlayback] that this player drives, for example to call [method SubtitlePlayback.get_active_segments].

method.name: get_playback_position
method.description: Returns the position of the own clock, or the last position read from the sync node, in seconds, without [member time_offset].

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the own clock runs, or, with a sync node, if the sync node was playing at the last update.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts the own clock at [param from_position] seconds and emits the segments active at that time. Not allowed with a [member sync_node]: play the sync node instead.

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves the own clock to [param position] seconds. While playing, the segments change at once (see [method SubtitlePlayback.seek]). Not allowed with a [member sync_node].

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the own clock, sets the position to [code]0.0[/code] and ends all active segments. Not allowed with a [member sync_node].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the own clock starts when the node is ready. Has no effect with a [member sync_node].

The subtitle to play. An explicitly set subtitle always wins, and [code]get_subtitle()[/code] returns only this one. If empty, the player takes the subtitle from the [member sync_node], see the description. Assigning another subtitle ends the active segments of the previous one.

The node whose time the player follows: an [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D] ([method AudioStreamPlayer.get_playback_position]), a [VideoStreamPlayer] ([member VideoStreamPlayer.stream_position]) or an [AnimationPlayer] ([member AnimationPlayer.current_animation_position]). The player follows it only while it is playing. If empty, the player uses its own clock.

Seconds added to the position before looking up segments. Positive values show segments earlier, negative values later. Use it to fix a delay between the audio and the subtitle without editing the [Subtitle].

signal.name: segment_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the current segment changes: the active segment that started last, or [code]null[/code] if none is active. See [signal SubtitlePlayback.segment_changed].

signal.name: segment_ended
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] stops being active. See [signal SubtitlePlayback.segment_ended].

signal.name: segment_started
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] becomes active. See [signal SubtitlePlayback.segment_started].
